claims.text: Canada’s Accessibility Commissioner reported inspections of federally regulated organisations during 2025–2026 under the Accessible Canada Act and its regulations. The inspections concerned accessibility plans, feedback process descriptions and progress reports. Findings included documents published in inaccessible formats. These findings concern Canadian law. They are not EAA enforcement findings or results from the new ICT requirements due to take effect in 2027.
